    emit('failure',base,error=repr(error))
    raise

Actual server wrappers follow. Client command: frozen client source plus each footer through kubectl-home.ps1 exec -i -n coder bpfusion-cross-node-client-20261011-j5jj8 -- python3 /dev/stdin. All client stdout transferred unchanged before JSON archival.

/tmp/bpfusion-cross-node-full-fesqvg0u/wrapper.py
DIR='/tmp/bpfusion-cross-node-full-fesqvg0u'
RAW='bench/results/physical_network_smol_20261011.jsonl'
import os,subprocess,datetime,pathlib,time,json
os.chdir('/workspaces/repository')
env=os.environ.copy();env['BF_BIND']='10.42.1.238';env['HF_HOME']='/workspaces/.cache/huggingface'
subprocess.run(['./build/bpfusion_load','stream-attach'],check=True)
started=time.monotonic()
with open(DIR+'/executor.log','w') as f:
 p=subprocess.Popen(['./build/qwen_graph','HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M','300'],env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 pathlib.Path(DIR+'/child.pid').write_text(str(p.pid))
 print('EXECUTOR_PID',p.pid,flush=True)
 try:
  while 'resident Qwen ready' not in pathlib.Path(DIR+'/executor.log').read_text():
   assert p.poll() is None,'executor failed during capture'
   time.sleep(.05)
  with open(RAW,'a') as out:out.write(json.dumps(dict(event='bootstrap',pair=0,mode='resident',seconds=time.monotonic()-started))+'\n')
  pathlib.Path(DIR+'/ready').write_text(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
  code=p.wait()
  print('EXECUTOR_EXIT',code,datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),flush=True)
 finally:
  if p.poll() is None:p.terminate();p.wait(timeout=60)
  subprocess.run(['./build/bpfusion_load','stream-detach'],check=True)
  for n in ['bpfusion_ctl','bpfusion_stats','bpfusion_db']:pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/bpf/'+n).unlink(missing_ok=True)
 raise SystemExit(code)

/tmp/bpfusion-cross-node-full-v_zu_dvg/wrapper.py
DIR='/tmp/bpfusion-cross-node-full-v_zu_dvg'
RAW='bench/results/physical_network_qwen_20261011.jsonl'
import os,subprocess,datetime,pathlib,time,json
os.chdir('/workspaces/repository')
env=os.environ.copy();env['BF_BIND']='10.42.1.238';env['HF_HOME']='/workspaces/.cache/huggingface'
assert not pathlib.Path('/sys/module/bfusion_tx').exists()
started=time.monotonic()
with open(DIR+'/executor.log','w') as f:
 p=subprocess.Popen(["./build/qwen_graph_user_network_wait","Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct",'300'],env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 pathlib.Path(DIR+'/child.pid').write_text(str(p.pid))
 print('EXECUTOR_PID',p.pid,flush=True)
 try:
  while 'resident Qwen ready' not in pathlib.Path(DIR+'/executor.log').read_text():
   assert p.poll() is None,'executor failed during capture'
   time.sleep(.05)
  with open(RAW,'a') as out:out.write(json.dumps(dict(event='bootstrap',pair=0,mode="user-network-wait",seconds=time.monotonic()-started))+'\n')
  pathlib.Path(DIR+'/ready').write_text(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
  code=p.wait()
  print('EXECUTOR_EXIT',code,datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),flush=True)
 finally:
  if p.poll() is None:p.terminate();p.wait(timeout=60)
  assert not pathlib.Path('/sys/module/bfusion_tx').exists()
 raise SystemExit(code)

/tmp/bpfusion-cross-node-full-0ikwiufq/wrapper.py
DIR='/tmp/bpfusion-cross-node-full-0ikwiufq'
RAW='bench/results/physical_network_qwen_20261011.jsonl'
import os,subprocess,datetime,pathlib,time,json
os.chdir('/workspaces/repository')
env=os.environ.copy();env['BF_BIND']='10.42.1.238';env['HF_HOME']='/workspaces/.cache/huggingface'
subprocess.run(['./build/bpfusion_load','stream-attach'],check=True)
started=time.monotonic()
with open(DIR+'/executor.log','w') as f:
 p=subprocess.Popen(["./build/qwen_graph","Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct",'300'],env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 pathlib.Path(DIR+'/child.pid').write_text(str(p.pid))
 print('EXECUTOR_PID',p.pid,flush=True)
 try:
  while 'resident Qwen ready' not in pathlib.Path(DIR+'/executor.log').read_text():
   assert p.poll() is None,'executor failed during capture'
   time.sleep(.05)
  with open(RAW,'a') as out:out.write(json.dumps(dict(event='bootstrap',pair=1,mode="resident",seconds=time.monotonic()-started))+'\n')
  pathlib.Path(DIR+'/ready').write_text(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
  code=p.wait()
  print('EXECUTOR_EXIT',code,datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),flush=True)
 finally:
  if p.poll() is None:p.terminate();p.wait(timeout=60)
  subprocess.run(['./build/bpfusion_load','stream-detach'],check=True)
  for n in ['bpfusion_ctl','bpfusion_stats','bpfusion_db']:pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/bpf/'+n).unlink(missing_ok=True)
 raise SystemExit(code)
